stories.title: Jesse & Joy son los Oasis mexicanos

en.title: Jesse & Joy are the Mexican Oasis
en.summary: Jesse & Joy, a Mexican musical act, are being compared to or associated with the characteristics of the band Oasis.

stories.title: En el MARCO, 90 obras que recorren la carrera del artista cubano Flavio Garciandía

en.title: At the MARCO, 90 works spanning the career of Cuban artist Flavio Garciandía
en.summary: Cuban artist Flavio Garciandía is presenting a retrospective exhibition of 90 works at the MARCO, including a piece titled Unauthorized Self-Portrait.

stories.title: Reservan de nuevo la información del atentado contra Citlalli Hernández

en.title: Information about the attack on Citlalli Hernández is sealed again
en.summary: Details regarding an attack on Citlalli Hernández have been sealed or restricted from public access.

stories.title: Se cumplen 475 AÑOS de la Universidad de México

en.title: University of Mexico marks 475 years
en.summary: The University of Mexico is commemorating its 475th anniversary.

en.title: Xochimilco also sounds like mariachi
en.summary: The headline indicates that mariachi music is associated with or present in Xochimilco, a historic area in Mexico City known for its canals and cultural significance.

stories.title: PRI reclama al INE sesionar a distancia en proceso

en.title: PRI demands INE hold sessions remotely in process
en.summary: Mexico's PRI political party is requesting that the National Electoral Institute conduct its sessions via remote means during an electoral process.

stories.title: México y Corea trazan estrategia hacia 2030

en.title: Mexico and South Korea chart strategy toward 2030
en.summary: Mexico's President Claudia Sheinbaum and South Korean official Lee Jae Myung agreed to expand bilateral cooperation in trade, culture, artificial intelligence, supply chains, and security.

stories.title: El Papa León XIV llega a París para su gira de cuatro días por Francia; fue recibido por Emmanuel Macron y un séquito de personas

en.title: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Paris for four-day tour of France; received by Emmanuel Macron and entourage
en.summary: The Pope is visiting Paris for a four-day trip to France, welcomed by President Macron. His itinerary includes meetings with young people and a Saturday mass at Place de la Concorde.

en.title: Electoral Defender
en.summary: A collection of editorial cartoons offering commentary on current political and electoral circumstances through artistic perspective.

stories.title: Diésel, sigue el suspenso. ¿Podremos evitar esta tormenta?

en.title: Diesel, the suspense continues. Can we avoid this storm?
en.summary: U.S. energy officials are considering options to address diesel supplies, including potential export restrictions or voluntary agreements with companies to increase domestic inventory and lower prices.

stories.title: Ambulancia del IMSS choca contra varios vehículos y atropella a joven en Azcapotzalco; conductor es detenido

en.title: IMSS ambulance crashes into multiple vehicles and hits young person in Azcapotzalco; driver detained
en.summary: An IMSS ambulance collided with nine other vehicles and struck a young person in Azcapotzalco, leading to the driver's arrest.

stories.title: Conduce ebrio ambulancia del IMSS y choca en Azcapotzalco

en.title: Intoxicated ambulance operator crashes in Azcapotzalco
en.summary: An IMSS ambulance operator drove while under the influence of alcohol, struck a pedestrian, and collided with multiple vehicles in Mexico City's Azcapotzalco neighborhood.

stories.title: México reabre segundo cruce para exportar ganado a EU; CNA exige más recursos sanitarios

en.title: Mexico reopens second crossing to export cattle to US; CNA demands more sanitary resources
en.summary: Mexico reopened a second border crossing for cattle exports to the United States, initially allowing 800 head daily with increases to 1,500 by week four. The sanitary authority requested budget increases and additional resources to support the operation.

stories.title: ¿Cuánto cuesta acceder a preventas? Tarjetas de crédito se convierten en requisito para comprar boletos de conciertos

en.title: How much does pre-sale access cost? Credit cards become a requirement to buy concert tickets
en.summary: Concert pre-sales increasingly require specific credit cards as a practical requirement for accessing tickets, turning card ownership into a barrier for attendance.

stories.title: ¿Tu teléfono te escucha? Esta función de Google puede guardar tus grabaciones de voz

en.title: Is your phone listening to you? This Google feature can save your voice recordings
en.summary: A little-known Google Account setting allows storage of audio recordings from voice searches and interactions, and users can check whether this feature is enabled.

stories.title: Por inflación, gasolinas, refrescos y cigarros incrementarán IEPS en 2027

en.title: Due to inflation, gasoline, soft drinks and cigarettes will increase excise taxes in 2027
en.summary: Mexico will adjust special taxes on gasoline, diesel, soft drinks and cigarettes in 2027 based on inflation recorded in December 2026, estimated at 3.8% annually.

stories.title: La adopción del streaming crece en zonas rurales mientras que en zonas urbanas empieza a moderarse

en.title: Streaming adoption grows in rural areas while moderating in urban zones
en.summary: The shift of sports and entertainment content from traditional television to digital platforms is driving streaming adoption in rural areas, while growth slows in urban regions.
